about: AD-19 (specs/coa/decisions.md; SM-07): which section of a lab report is a lot's value of record, given the lot id the state links the report to and the state's psilocybin for that lot (mg/g, null when it has none). The lot's own UID first (its of_record section); else the one batch the report's own request / chain of custody pairs the lot with ('Batch ID' then 'Lot/Process Lot', the id on the same line or the next), when that batch's section is a primary; else the one primary section whose psilocybin equals the state's figure at 3 significant figures. Anything else is not found (null). coa_core::lot::find_lot is held to these (tests/lot_cases.rs, and through the binding coa/tests/test_lot_cases.py). 'report' is a corpus case folder; 'expect' is the section found: its uid, whether it is a field duplicate, and how it was found.
